# Wnode Sovereign Compute & Wireless Mesh

> A planetary, RAM-only distributed edge compute and decentralized wireless (DeWi) mesh monetizing idle consumer silicon via Stripe USD payouts and bounded two-tier rev-share.

## Core Architecture & Safety Invariants
- Stateless RAM Execution: Workloads run entirely in volatile memory sandboxes (mlock isolation). Zero disk persistence, zero permanent storage writes, and zero SSD wear.
- Fiat-First Flow-Through: 70% of gross compute job spend flows directly to node operators via Stripe Connect in USD. No token volatility or crypto wallet friction.
- Universal Commodity Hardware: Lightweight native binaries (nodld) run bare-metal across Windows, Linux, and macOS host OSes.
- Bounded Partner Economics: 10% permanent Sales Source fee on client compute acquisition; bounded two-tier overrides (3% Level 1, 7% Level 2) with zero recruitment quotas.
- Circular Eco-Compute: Zero evaporative water cooling and zero new concrete construction; dissipates thermal load across ambient consumer devices.

## Architectural Solutions & Search Hubs
- [DePIN Commodity Hardware](https://wnode.one/depin-hardware-nodes): Monetizing everyday PCs and laptops with native bare-metal Go runners instead of $600 proprietary miners.
- [Passive Hardware Income](https://wnode.one/passive-hardware-income): 3-click background execution converting idle CPU and GPU headroom into predictable USD revenue.
- [Anti-Wear Mining Alternatives](https://wnode.one/alternatives-to-mining): Stateless memory-resident compute sandboxes eliminating the SSD write exhaustion of storage nodes.
- [Repurpose Idle Silicon & ITAD](https://wnode.one/repurpose-old-pc): Circular tech diversion turning off-lease enterprise desktops and surplus computers into revenue assets.
- [DeWi & Micro-ISP Network](https://wnode.one/dewi-micro-isp): Off-grid wireless mesh combining sub-GHz LoRa/Reticulum packet relays with local compute execution.
- [Two-Tier Partner Program](https://wnode.one/two-tier-affiliate-program): Bounded two-tier recurring revenue share model paying automated cash flow-through via Stripe.

## Network Endpoints
- [Network Root](https://wnode.one): Public platform home and architecture specifications.
- [Node Operator Onboarding](https://nodlr.wnode.one): Native Go runner installation and live hardware telemetry.
- [Compute Mesh Client Portal](https://mesh.wnode.one): Decentralized spot inference and micro-task dispatch.
- [Privacy Disclosures](https://wnode.one/privacy): CCPA & GDPR compliant data minimization and zero disk retention guarantees.
